_method: Every image under downloads/hull-examples was inspected visually (vision-model read, 2026-08-25) and its geometric content transcribed here. downloads/ is GITIGNORED, so this file is the durable record and must stand WITHOUT the images (gap J5's lesson: an analysis that silently depends on a file only one machine has). source_image paths are local-only provenance. Quantities read off a drawing carry sigma_source='drawing'; quantities printed as text on the sheet carry sigma_source='sheet-label'. Nothing here restates a grammar bound or a gate number - those live in navalai/grammar.py and data/gate-ledger.json.
_expressibility_note: expressibility verdicts reference the 23-gene grammar at commit 0c1286d and name the blocking mechanism, not a number. They MUST be re-verdicted when the grammar moves (same discipline as formlib.Expressible, whose axe_bow/wave_piercing verdicts went stale on 2026-08-24 when flare_bow/flare_len landed).

taxonomy._derivation: clustered from the records below, not imposed. Families the corpus actually contains, with the images that attest them.

hybrid_topology.note: the owner's design line. Topology-CHANGING transition (one closed section splits into two) - the geometric operation the single-surface genome cannot express; built today by scripts/hookprobe_hull.py outside the genome.

transition_rules._derivation: longitudinal behaviours recurring across >=3 independent sources; these are the 'design grammar' the corpus teaches, stated as constructions, not adjectives.
transition_rules.vertical_to_horizontal: Bow sections are V/vertical-plane dominated (deep-V entry, axe stem, wave-piercer); stern sections flatten toward horizontal-plane (planing flat, wide transom, wet deck). Deadrise warps continuously bow->stern; the corpus never shows constant deadrise except the prismatic Fridsma-type models. Attested: trawler-triptych semi-displacement ('hard chines aft'), five-body-plans warped variants, hookprobe deep-V->wet-deck, claude-training-sheet 'variable deadrise'.
transition_rules.teardrop_plan: Efficient displacement plans read as a water-drop: fine entry (labelled <9-12 deg half-angle on three sheets), max beam at 0.55-0.65 x/L from the bow, gentle taper to a narrower immersed transom (beam_transom/beam_max ~ 0.3-0.7). Attested: solar-slender-cruiser plan, hookprobe-concept plan (max beam ~0.6 L from bow, stern 4 m on 12 m LOA), amel-50 deck plan, orion-49.
transition_rules.chine_evolution: A chine is a CURVE with behaviour, not a constant: rises toward the bow, may terminate before the stem or merge into it, hard aft / soft forward is the recurring hybrid. Attested: trawler-triptych ('hard chines aft' with round forward), five-body-plans double-chine, claude-training-sheet chine annotations, bowrider-photo strakes.
transition_rules.flare_inversion: Wave-piercer bows carry zero-to-negative flare (tumblehome) above water ('zero flare volume' on axe-swath-sheet) while conventional bows flare outward; flare must vary along the length AND change sign. Attested: axe-swath-sheet, ref-library-sheet axe/wave-piercing cells, research corpus (Damen/Baltic).
transition_rules.section_field: A hull is a field of sections evolving under independent longitudinal laws (beam(x), deadrise(x), chine_height(x), flare(x), rocker(x), sheer(x)) - never one section scaled. The spearhead failure is exactly single-curve scaling. Attested: every multi-view sheet; codified from ml-hull-generation.md par.4.
transition_rules.topology_split: The hybrid family runs: single closed section (bow) -> progressive widening of a centreline tunnel -> two closed demihull sections + wet deck (stern). Lines EXCHANGE ROLES (houseboat17: centre keel rises into tunnel crown; chines descend into demihull keels). A generator supports this only with an inner section boundary.
transition_rules.stability_recovery: Slenderness costs transverse stability; the corpus resolves it four ways: add hulls (cat/tri/amas), spray-rail/lifting-chine (research corpus, Seo), tunnel/cathedral tri-hedral forms, or SWATH platform. Nobody's answer is free (ml-hull-generation.md par.8).

propulsion_architectures._derivation: owner protocol 2026-08-25 (docs/research/PROPULSION-INTEGRATION.md par.6): the architecture is chosen WITH the hull topology, and the hull exists to deliver the propulsor a controlled, uniform, low-loss inflow. What the corpus itself attests:
propulsion_architectures.integrated_motor_pod: hookprobe-concept-teardrop: pod + propeller faired INTO the stern underbody, rudder behind - the pod is part of the moulded form, not an attachment.
propulsion_architectures.protected_prop_in_tunnel: hookprobe-owner-sketch BACK view: propeller inside an arch/tunnel between two skeg/demihull volumes - shallow-water protection + controlled inflow; houseboat17's tunnel emerges from the lines the same way.
propulsion_architectures.twin_demihull_streams: hookprobe-schematic: the mono-to-twin split organizes stern flow into two clean propulsion streams - the topology IS the propulsion architecture (protocol par.14).
propulsion_architectures.conventional_shaft: heyman-42-sections/orion-49: shaft exit ahead of skeg-hung or spade rudder, prop in the keel-shadow wake - the classical wake-first arrangement.
propulsion_architectures.outboard_planing: bowrider-photo: transom-hung drive behind a strake-and-chine-flat planing bottom; the strakes condition the flow that reaches the prop.

records.content: Symmetric catamaran front sections (demihull L/Bh > 12 labelled, wet-deck clearance dimensioned, deep-V demihulls with spray knuckles), trimaran and planing-hull profiles. Demihull sections drawn as narrow deep-V with flared topsides.

reconstruction_protocol.order: reference record -> feature analysis (this file) -> parametric interpretation (genome where expressible, direct lines->sections->loft where not) -> generated hull STL -> multi-view render -> visual + descriptor comparison -> correction loop. Reconstruct BEFORE generating novelty (protocol par.23).
targets_chosen: claude-training-sheet deep-V 24deg (planing family, in-box deadrise, warp via beta_run) - measures the warped-V residual
hookprobe-schematic (hybrid topology, OUT-of-genome) - proves the lines->sections->loft path against the owner's drawing
reconstruction_protocol.visual_score: morphology.describe descriptors compared against the record's quantities (entry angle, x of max beam, beam_transom/beam_max, beam_carried) + anti-pattern critique + eyeball of rendered profile/plan/front/perspective against the source image. The critic's family bias (no axe/piercer row in _FAMILY_BAR) is a KNOWN defect - a WAVY-PLAN/SPEARHEAD flag on a deliberate piercer is recorded, not obeyed.
